what_this_decides: Whether each of the five weight_time catalog SNAPSHOTS (its identity and its descriptive/discovery metadata) is approved for release. This is NOT a decision about instructional content; that is family B, in weight-time-five-entry-content-review-form.json.

database_effect_when_completed.mechanism: direct owner UPDATE on public.exercise_catalog, resolved by logical_id AND is_active = true
database_effect_when_completed.audit: reviewed_by, reviewed_at, review_rationale are written from this form; one immutable row is appended to exercise_catalog_review_events by the freeze trigger, per identity
database_effect_when_completed.downstream_hard_dependency: the delivery-run seal (exlib_approve_and_seal_run) independently re-checks reviewed_by and review_rationale on every exercise member, so a blank rationale here blocks the seal four stages later

preparer_boundary: Claude and ChatGPT may prepare and validate this form but may NEVER fill or fabricate any requested input. Process authorization to work quickly is NOT a substantive approval verdict.
no_effect_statement: Blank or null NEVER reads as approval. A partially completed decision is not a decision.
decision_requirements: A decision requires decision, reviewer (a named human, never AI, >= 3 non-blank chars), reviewer_role_or_credential (operator-validated), reviewed_at (date-time with offset), and rationale (>= 10 non-blank chars) together. Optional evidence never substitutes for them. Per-identity rationale text may differ or may be shared, but it must be non-blank for every identity that is approved.
decision_choices_provenance: Taken verbatim from the promoted snapshot-review form docs/exlib2v-plank-snapshot-review-form.json, not invented here. The form vocabulary is deliberately distinct from the database vocabulary.

decision_choice_to_database_value.APPROVE: review_status = 'approved' (the only choice this round's packages implement)
decision_choice_to_database_value.REJECT: review_status = 'rejected' - no package is prepared for this; it would end the release
decision_choice_to_database_value.CORRECT: review_status = 'revised' - no package is prepared for this; a metadata correction at catalog_version 1 is not an edit, it requires a new catalog version

provenance_coupling_is_constraint_enforc.note: The source-field posture shown per entry below is not a convention, it is enforced by two named CHECK constraints added by migration 027, and the packages assert both.
provenance_coupling_is_constraint_enforc.exercise_catalog_provenance_sources_chk: external_source_derived requires ALL FOUR of source_url, source_page, retrieved_at, import_confidence non-null; forgefitos_original requires ALL FOUR null. This is why entries 137, 138 and 139 show four nulls and entries 132 and 133 show four values.
provenance_coupling_is_constraint_enforc.exercise_catalog_discovery_metadata_chk: forgefitos_original additionally requires movement_pattern, training_role, difficulty and availability all non-null.

scope_note: EXACTLY these five identities. Inventory lines 134 Farmer's carry, 135 Suitcase carry and 136 Sandbag bear-hug carry are explicitly OUT OF SCOPE and DEFERRED, and appear in no artifact in this round.
snapshot_fields_this_decision_freezes: Approving a snapshot approves its identity and all of its descriptive and discovery metadata as shown above. Every one of those fields is immutable at catalog_version 1 thereafter; changing one later requires a new catalog version, not an edit.
open_reviewer_questions: RQ-2 (identity/metadata): entry 133 currently carries the SAME URL as both source_url and source_page. That is lawful (they are separate columns and the UNIQUE index is on (source_url, catalog_version)), and it was ruled that way in the frozen W14 field decisions. It is restated here only so approval is informed, not to reopen it.

RQ-3 (identity/metadata): entry 138 is the only one of the five with availability = 'minimal' rather than 'home_gym', because a wall and one plate is the least equipment of the five. Confirm that distinction is intended.
